title: the 11 POP tracks' D0-day-dry baselines (the first audit-batch item)

existingCapability.shardMatrix: auto: [0,1,2,3,4,5] (the depth's default branch in the strategy filter - weather_review is not in any named shard list, so it falls to the final fallback)
existingCapability.rowSet: (tod,wet) in ((0,0),(3,0),(0,2),(3,3),(0,4)) per track = the full wet/night matrix in ONE dispatch; D0 = the (0,0) row
existingCapability.note: one dispatch covers batch A AND the whole matrix bonus (60 tracks x 5 rows = ~300 captures); the POP-11 D0 rows are the review-first subset

proposedMinimalAddition.purpose: a D0-ONLY quick battery item (60 PNGs instead of ~300) when the owner wants the batch-A verdicts before the fullmatrix run
proposedMinimalAddition.workflowEdit: inputs: weather_rows: {description: 'csv of tod_wet pairs for the WEATHER_REVIEW matrix', type: string, default: '0_0,3_0,0_2,3_3,0_4'}; env: WEATHER_ROWS: ${{ inputs.weather_rows }}
proposedMinimalAddition.toolEdit: cloud_game_audit.py WEATHER_REVIEW branch: replace the literal tuple loop with rows parsed from os.environ.get('WEATHER_ROWS','0_0,3_0,0_2,3_3,0_4') (pairs split on ',' then '_')
proposedMinimalAddition.batchACommand: gh workflow run game-review.yml --repo Jdiejei/mysim-godot --ref codex/repair-20261029 -f depth=weather_review -f weather_rows=0_0
proposedMinimalAddition.owner: verification folds the two-line patch; the dispatch stays owner-side

dispatchCommands: gh workflow run game-review.yml --repo Jdiejei/mysim-godot --ref codex/repair-20261029 -f depth=weather_review
gh run download <run-id> --repo Jdiejei/mysim-godot -n encrypted-review-<shard>-attempt-1   # per shard 0..5
# decrypt per the established review-key flow (MYSIM_INTAKE_KEY; key never printed)
captureSemantics: each D0 row = MYSIM_TRACK=<N>, MYSIM_CAR=16 (the reference car), MYSIM_TOD=0, MYSIM_WET=0, AI-on/autodrive, no pit/rivals, 3 s drive-by shot (the file names = the audit's f'weather-track-{track:02}-tod-{tod}-wet-{wet}' labels)
nameSource: all names verified against the per-track index files (generated from data/TrackList.json)

rows: track-D0 baseline visual state (per POP track): claim = 'track<N> D0 day/dry baseline captures (batch A/audit plan)', run = the weather_review run id, head = the dispatch head, evidence = the decrypted weather-track-<NN>-tod-0-wet-0.png path, verdict = open
ledgerContract.owner: verification files the rows; this agent proposes row content only

verdictProtocol: the D0-first review: the 11 POP D0 frames reviewed BEFORE any night/wet row; defects recorded per track only with the row's capture attached (no defect rows without captures)
